reviewer_scope: Independently read all 136 nonretail paragraphs with all 99 cited own-date headline records. Checked every concrete headline assertion, Polish translation, attribution, company role, actual-versus-preview status, source age, scenario and stance. Independently compared every quoted market and Treasury figure against its correct own-date instrument, session, horizon and unit. Re-read all three named fixes and reran verification. No later-date factual source justified an August 9 claim.

basis: The US chapter compares the one-session rebound with the twenty-session decline and distinguishes manufacturing contraction from services expansion and lower mortgage rates.

China connects weak manufacturer/consumer profits, services resilience, bank credit risk, property oversupply, currency sensitivity and the EV sales milestone rather than repeating a generic stimulus thesis.

Poland distinguishes PKO ex-dividend price effects from operating deterioration, Pekao provisions from Alior one-offs, housing affordability from marketplace competition, and policy intentions from completed procurement.

Sectors use contrasting actual company evidence, including Palantir/JFrog, Lilly/CVS, Caterpillar/Embraer, consumer travel/value formats, and SMIC/Infineon. Stances vary with those operating differences.
The flows chapter separates carry funding, credit spreads, actual issuance, investor selling and repurchases. Scenarios preserve the uncertainty of Nvidia earnings and Middle East diplomacy.

findings.action: Changed Palantir deploying products to plans to deploy, preserving the future wording of Reuters n0849. No amount or timing of revenue is inferred.
Replaced Poland input narration about what a headline does not supply with direct analysis of debt service and public investment.
Added exact unemployment, provision and housing-price citations to Poland divergence synthesis.

All quoted levels and one/five/twenty-observation returns match their own instruments. The 2Y/10Y yields, negative five-bps spread and bull steepening agree with Treasury. Crypto uses the completed UTC candle. PKO price changes explicitly exclude dividend wealth effects; numeric spot-FX is absent.

Nvidia n0716 is a forecast despite its broad RSS result label; its August 6 timestamp is within the stricter seven-day preview window and the prose explicitly treats it as pending. ECB July 18 unchanged-rate/data-dependent guidance is a current policy baseline within 35 days, with no later decision asserted. Lilly, SMIC, Disney and other August 8/7 results are already available at this cutoff.

A separate independent exact counter found small length violations not surfaced by verify.py. Targeted trims or useful brief risk sentences now put all36 blocks inside their exact bounds; financial claims and citations are unchanged. Named log: review_scratch/2024-08-09_range_fixes.json.

limits: Exact RSS headlines and historical cards do not establish full publisher article contents or original unrevised vintages.
Acceptance covers only this exact nonretail component; retail is reviewed separately and later edits require renewed binding.

exact_block_ranges.method: Independent paragraph-body whitespace count after removing canonical citation tokens; all36 exact AUTHORING bounds.
